Several hours, over 2 or more sessions (two lever rooms for 5, a 2-hour window for the cocoons and the final boss)

{npc:Gunther}, in Edron, has seen a gigantic plant advancing across the sea towards the mainland: it is {wiki:Podzilla|Podzilla}, yet another plan by {creature:Doctor Marrow (Podzilla)|Doctor Marrow}. Sail to it with {npc:Captain Seahorse}, enter through the plant's mouth, ally with the rootthings ({npc:Two Lips} and {npc:Sprout Sentinel}) and complete the missions inside until you reach Doctor Marrow's lair. At the end you defeat {creature:The Rootkraken}, receive the base {wiki:Rootwalker Outfits|Rootwalker} outfit and, on your first victory over the boss, an {item:Amber Crusher}.
Minimum level **300** (recommended **600+**): Podzilla's difficulty is comparable to that of {wiki:Ingol} and the {wiki:Secret Library}.
Team: the *Protect the Bloom* and *For The Sprout* rooms have a lever for 5 players and the final boss is done as a team, with a {wiki:Knight} tanking.
The wiki does not require any previous quest. The story continues from {wiki:The Cradle of Monsters Quest} (the villain is the same Doctor Marrow).
so you can talk to the rootthings; drops from the rootthings in the hunting area and is tradeable (Market)
several, to cut the roots of the Crimson Death Blossom; they drop from Rootthing Amber Shapers and break after a few uses or 2 hours
a few, to throw at the Powergenerators (Coin Toss mission and final boss)
Protection against **physical** and **death** damage for the final boss (and against **earth** only while Doctor Marrow is attacking you)
Optional for the boss: seeds ({item:Preserved Dark Seed}, {item:Preserved Red Seed}, {item:Preserved Pink Seed}, etc.) to plant Blooming Towers
Plenty of potions and runes: almost all the missions take place in the Podzilla hunting area (level 600)
optional, as an emergency exit: the wiki does not describe the exits from the task rooms, the boss room or Podzilla
guaranteed in the loot the first time you kill The Rootkraken
Base {wiki:Rootwalker Outfits|Rootwalker} outfit (male and female), given by {npc:Two Lips} at the end

{creature:The Rootkraken} loot (700,000 experience): {item:Crystal Coin|Crystal Coins}, {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}, potions, giant gems, amber weapons ({item:Amber Sabre}, {item:Amber Bludgeon}, {item:Amber Greataxe}, {item:Amber Kusarigama}), {item:Collar of Orange Plasma}, {item:Root Tentacle} and {item:Strange Inedible Fruit} (1st Rootwalker addon)
When you enter through the plant's mouth at the end of the mission *A Dangerous Journey*.
After the first successful voyage: ask {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron for a {key:shortcut} and you will not have to repeat the sailing.
When you say {key:worth} to {npc:Two Lips} after destroying the Crimson Death Blossom.
When you complete the mission *Coin Toss*: the orb south of the task teleport (floor -3) takes you to the last floor, where the lever for {creature:The Rootkraken} is.
After *Coin Toss*, through the lever in the central area of the last floor.
When you say {key:leader} to {npc:Two Lips} after killing The Rootkraken.
With the base outfit: the addons are obtained by using a {item:Strange Inedible Fruit} and a {item:Petrified Leaf}.
Buy the {item:Demon Root} on the Market before you go (it is tradeable): that way you do not have to hunt rootthings just to be able to talk to Two Lips.

Plan around the 2-hour window: when you cut the roots of the Crimson Death Blossom, the cocoons for the *Symbiosis* mission appear for 2 hours. If you are not going to do everything in one go, get at least as far as that mission; otherwise you will have to repeat the Bucklers and the roots.

Keywords: the spoiler only documents {key:gunther} and {key:shortcut} (Captain Seahorse), {key:help} (Atui), {key:worth} and {key:leader} (Two Lips). For the other reports, talk to the NPC ({key:hi}) and follow the words highlighted in the dialogue.
Do the missions in a party with shared experience: in the *Symbiosis* mission the kills count for all members who are nearby and deal damage.
Always keep a few {item:Gold Coin|Gold Coins} in your backpack: they are needed in the *Coin Toss* mission and again at the final boss.

The wiki does not describe how to get out of the lever rooms (*Protect the Bloom*, *For The Sprout*, *Coin Toss*), the boss room or from Podzilla back to Edron. Bring a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} as a fallback: it takes you to your city's temple, but it does not work in No-Logout zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block. Afterwards you return to Podzilla via {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s {key:shortcut}.
Gunther is looking for an adventurer: he has seen a huge plant sailing slowly across the open sea, heading straight for the mainland.

If you are not in **Edron**, take a boat: talk to the harbour captain in your city (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais) and say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at Edron's harbour, **north** of the city, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s boat. {npc:Gunther} is in Edron castle, a little **south** of the harbour.

Talk to {npc:Gunther} ({key:hi}). He tells you he saw a gigantic plant in the sea on the way to the mainland and invites you to stop it and destroy it. Accept the invitation and he sends you to the Edron ship to talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.
Board {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s boat in Edron's north harbour and tell him about Gunther: {key:hi} and {key:gunther}. Board the ship that takes you to the plant.
Once on the ship, you realise you can only defeat the plant from the inside: you have to sail to it and enter through its mouth.
Use the ship's **lever** to start sailing.
Sail west to the plant's mouth

Keep sailing **west**, towards the giant plant, and enter through its **mouth**. Along the way {creature:Storm|Storms}, {wiki:Water Vortex|Water Vortexes} and {creature:Ghost Ship|Ghost Ships} appear: they cast lots of area spells, lower your counter and can cause {wiki:Feared|fear} (your character runs away out of control). Stay away from them.
If the counter reaches **zero**, you fail the task and have to wait **10 minutes** before trying again.
After the first successful trip you no longer need to repeat the voyage: whenever you want to go back to Podzilla, go to {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron and ask him for the {key:shortcut}.
Direct access to Podzilla from Edron
3. Looking for Clues and Contact the Plant People
Once inside the plant, look for clues about what is going on and find allies among the rootthings, the plant people.

You disembark on the **ground floor** of Podzilla. Leave the ship and talk to {npc:Atui}, nearby, to offer him help: {key:hi} and {key:help}. He greets you and says straight away that the place is lost, corrupted by the vile touch of Doctor Marrow.
Podzilla (image released with the 2024 summer update)

To be able to talk to the plant people you have to eat a {item:Demon Root}. It drops from any rootthing in the hunting area (the Stalk): {creature:Rootthing Amber Shaper}, {creature:Rootthing Bug Tracker} and {creature:Rootthing Nutshell}. Since it is tradeable, you can also buy it on the Market before you come.
To enter the hunting area use the **vortex teleport**; the first floor of the area is floor -1.
Use (eat) the {item:Demon Root}. The message *You feel countless tiny roots burrowing into your brain!* appears and you can now talk to the rootthings.
You become {wiki:Drunk|Superdrunk} after eating it (the spoiler says a few seconds; the item page says 1 minute): do not do it while surrounded by monsters.
Go back to Podzilla's ground floor and enter the **green teleport** to the **north-west**. Go up the stairs: {npc:Two Lips} is 1 floor up.
Talk to {npc:Two Lips} ({key:hi}) and offer to help him destroy the invaders. Before he trusts you, he asks you to prove your worth by destroying the **Crimson Death Blossom**.
The spoiler does not give the exact word to offer help to Two Lips: use the highlighted word in his dialogue (with Atui it is {key:help}).
The flower is protected by 13 **Rootthing Bucklers** and the roots have a magic shield. You have to kill the Bucklers, break the shield and cut 10 roots with Amber Sickles.
Enter the hunting area through the **vortex teleport** and, on the first floor (floor -1), head **south**. The entrance to the Crimson Death Blossom's lair is at {coord:33848,32058,8}.
Entrance to the Crimson Death Blossom's lair

To cut the roots you need {item:Amber Sickle|Amber Sickles}. They drop from {creature:Rootthing Amber Shaper|Rootthing Amber Shapers}. Each sickle breaks after a few uses or after **2 hours** in your backpack, so you will almost certainly need more than one: be quick.

The spoiler's advice for getting more time to cut: bring all the **Rootthing Bucklers** down to low health, break the roots with a melee weapon and, when you are ready, kill all 13 as fast as possible. The faster you kill them, the more time you have to cut before any of them respawns.
Kill the 13 Bucklers and break the shield
Kill the **13 Rootthing Bucklers**. With all of them dead, the roots' magic shield can be broken with **any weapon**.
Use the {item:Amber Sickle} on the flower's roots. You have to cut **10 roots** in total; your progress shows in the questlog.
As soon as a Buckler respawns you can no longer cut roots. If that happens, kill them again.

With the flower destroyed, head back to the surface: return to Podzilla's ground floor the way you came, enter the green teleport to the **north-west** and go up to {npc:Two Lips}. Say {key:worth} to prove your worth: he gives you access to the sacred garden.
Access to the sacred garden. For 2 hours, rootthings deal less spell damage to everyone who took part.

Cutting all the roots makes the cocoons (Rootthing Cocoons) appear in the hunting areas for **2 hours**, for all players. They are needed for the *Symbiosis* mission (section 8). The 2-hour timer restarts whenever someone does this mission again.
Protect **The Bloom** from the **Invader Bugs** with flowers that grow from seeds. There is no danger in this room: you only need gear to deal damage.
Right to the **east** of {npc:Two Lips} there is a teleport. Enter it: you reach a room with a **5-player lever**. Gather your team and pull the lever.
Kill plants and pick up seeds
Kill the **Wildly Growing Plants** in the room and pick up the random seed they drop.

Drag the seed to the **floor below**, onto a square of **fertile soil**. A flower of the seed's colour grows and spends **1 minute** casting spells at any bugs nearby. Each colour has a different spell pattern.
Each **Invader Bug** killed gives 1 point. You win the mission at **100 points**.
You fail if **The Bloom**'s counter reaches 0.
Leave the room and go back to {npc:Two Lips} (same floor, west of the teleport) to report and receive the next mission. The wiki does not describe the exit from this room.
The **Quara Kindlers** are attacking the **Rootthing Conservators** to destroy the **Plant Heart** (the plant's heart). You have to put out the fire.
Go back to the hunting area and go down to floor **-2**. Head **north-east** to a **heart**-shaped room.
Put out the fire with Potent Dew

The heart has a fire counter of **100** points. Pick up the {item:Potent Dew|Potent Dews} from the floor and use them on the heart: each one lowers the counter by 1, but it goes back up after a short while. You and every player in the room complete the mission when the counter next to the heart reaches **1**.
There is a lot going on in the room and it is easy to miss the questlog message: check that the flames have gone from the heart or open the questlog.
Go back to the surface the way you came down (ground floor, green teleport to the **north-west**, go up) and report to {npc:Two Lips} again.
With the heart healed and the fire out, the spells of all the Quara in Podzilla become weaker (while the heart burns they are 5% stronger).
7. Going Deeper and For The Sprout
The Sprout Sentinel needs help against the bugs attacking the sprouts, using the power of rotten plant matter.
Go back to floor **-2** of the hunting area and head **north-west** to the {npc:Sprout Sentinel}. He says he needs your help and asks you to kill the pest bugs with the power of rotten plant matter.
Enter the For The Sprout room
Enter the teleport next to the {npc:Sprout Sentinel}. You reach another room with a **5-player lever**; gather your team and pull it.

Go up the stairs, kill the **Writhing Masses** and stand on the **green vortex** that appears when they die. You become charged with corrupted energy and your character starts casting **waves or beams** in a random pattern.

Go down and use those waves and beams to kill the **Pest Bugs** trying to destroy the **Fledgling Sprouts**. You need **100** Pest Bugs killed. The charge runs out after about **1 minute**: when that happens, go back up, kill another Writhing Mass and repeat until you are done.
Your waves and beams also hurt the sprouts you are protecting. Choose your position carefully so you do not kill them.
Leave the room and go back to the {npc:Sprout Sentinel} (floor -2, next to the teleport you entered through) to report. The wiki does not describe the exit from this room.
8. The Root of Evil and Symbiosis (cocoons)
The Crimson Death Blossom has not been defeated yet: it has spread **Rootthing Cocoons** across the hunting area and you have to destroy them.
When you report, the {npc:Sprout Sentinel} tells you that the Crimson Death Blossom is still alive and has spread cocoons around, which have to be destroyed.
The cocoons only exist for **2 hours** after someone kills the 13 **Rootthing Bucklers** and cuts all the roots of the Crimson Death Blossom (section 4).
If the 2 hours have passed, go back to the flower's lair ({coord:33848,32058,8}) and redo the Bucklers and the roots before looking for cocoons.
The cocoons are in the **corners** of floors -1 and -2. They are not hard to spot, but they are often in the middle of large groups of creatures. Locations on floor -1:
Kill each cocoon: a new creature spawns in its place. Only the two *pupated* ones count for the mission; you need to kill **20**.
This is the one you are looking for
This is the one you are looking for
Only slows you down and deals a lot of damage
Deals a lot of {wiki:Mana Drain|mana drain}: do not get cornered by it
In a party with shared experience, kills count for every member within sharing range who dealt damage.
With 20 pupated rootthings killed, go back to the {npc:Sprout Sentinel} (floor -2, north-west) and report.
The Sprout Sentinel asks you to find a way to break Doctor Marrow's shimmering wall (shimmer-wall). The task is a maze with energy barriers and vegetation blocking the way to the generators.
Go down to floor **-3** of the hunting area and enter this task's teleport. Bring {item:Gold Coin|Gold Coins}!

The **Undergrowths** can be killed normally. If you stand on the square where one respawns, you force it to respawn somewhere else: do this so the team does not waste time killing the same one over and over.

The **Powered Energy Barriers** are destroyed when an **Overload** dies near them. To create an Overload, attack the **Charged Energy Coil** in the **centre** of the room. After creating the Overload it becomes an **Energy Coil** and you have to wait a few seconds until it charges again. Lure the Overload next to the barrier and kill it there.

Clear a path to a **Powergenerator** and throw a {item:Gold Coin} at it (drag the coin onto it). The generator takes damage and teleports to another random spot in the room. Repeat until you destroy it.
Access to Doctor Marrow's lair (shortcut south of this task's teleport).

The final fight is on the last floor of the hunting area, against {creature:The Rootkraken} and {creature:Doctor Marrow (Podzilla)|Doctor Marrow}. Recommended protection: **physical** and **death**; **earth** only when Doctor Marrow is attacking you. Do not forget the {item:Gold Coin|Gold Coins}.
With *Coin Toss* complete, you have access to a shortcut right **south** of the task teleport, on floor -3. Click the **orb** and go down the stairs.

On the last floor head to the **central area**, where {creature:The Rootkraken}'s lever is. Gather your team and pull it. The wiki does not give the maximum number of players, the cooldown or the time limit for this boss.

{creature:The Rootkraken} and {creature:Doctor Marrow (Podzilla)|Doctor Marrow} are in the room, but at the start **both are immune** to damage: do not waste time on them. Go up the stairs to the **west**, **north** or **east**, kill the **Writhing Masses** and stand on the **green vortexes** to become charged with corrupted energy (as in *For The Sprout*).

Once charged, go up the **south** stairs and position yourself to destroy the {creature:Rampant Barrier|Rampant Barriers} with the vortexes' automatic spells. Repeat (charge up and break barriers) until you reach the **Powergenerator**.
Over time, summoned plants keep appearing in the room, which makes the trips back and forth more and more dangerous.
Throw a {item:Gold Coin} at the **Powergenerator**, as in *Coin Toss*, until you destroy it. From then on both bosses in the main room can take damage: the goal is to kill {creature:The Rootkraken}.
Once the generator is destroyed you face:
Mostly earth, quite a lot of physical
Mostly physical, also earth and death
Appear in waves and evolve up to the Frenzied state
According to the boss page (values still to be confirmed on the wiki), the Rootkraken takes more damage from fire (115%) and earth (110%) and less from energy (85%).

You can damage Doctor Marrow (when he reaches about half his health, he flees and teleports out of the fight), but the recommended approach is to **lure him to the opposite side** of the room from where you will attack the Rootkraken. That way the {wiki:Knight} tanks better and does not get hit by the fear (Fear).
Fight in the **south / south-west** corner of the room: there you can trap the boss using the walls.

In the Frenzied state, the plants increase the *stacks* of the player they are attacking; the more stacks you have, the more damage you take from everything in the fight. The minimum number of stacks is 100 and they keep dropping by 10 every 4 seconds. Kill the plants before they reach Frenzied.

Just like in *Protect the Bloom*, you can plant {item:Blooming Tower (Dark)|Blooming Towers} on the soil squares spread around the room. It is not mandatory, but it helps damage the boss and control the plants. Here you have to bring your own seeds, which drop from the rootthings and the Quaras on Podzilla's first floors:
Rootthing Amber Shaper, Bug Tracker and Nutshell
Rootthing Amber Shaper, Bug Tracker and Nutshell
Rootthing Amber Shaper, Bug Tracker and Nutshell

Kill {creature:The Rootkraken}. The **first** time, the loot always includes an {item:Amber Crusher}: with it you crush unrevealed {wiki:Wheel of Destiny|gems} to get {item:Lesser Fragment|Lesser Fragments} and {item:Greater Fragment|Greater Fragments} (unlimited uses, up to 10 gems at a time).
Amber Crusher (first time) and the boss's normal loot

After the fight, go back to the surface the way you came down (the hunting area floors up to the ground floor), enter the green teleport to the **north-west** and go up to {npc:Two Lips}. The wiki does not describe the exit from the boss room: if you cannot find it, use a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} (you go to your city's temple) and return to Podzilla with {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s {key:shortcut}, in Edron.
Talk to {npc:Two Lips} and say {key:leader}. You receive the base **Rootwalker** outfit (male and female). The quest is complete.

The wiki does not document how to get back from Podzilla to Edron. Go to the ground floor, to the ship you disembarked from (near {npc:Atui}), and check on the spot whether there is a way back. If there is not, use a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll}: it takes you to your city's temple, but it does not work in No-Logout zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block. To return to Podzilla another day, use {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s {key:shortcut} in Edron.

With the base outfit you can do the {wiki:Rootwalker Outfits Quest|Rootwalker Outfits Quest}: you get the 1st addon by using a {item:Strange Inedible Fruit} (drops from the Rootkraken) and the 2nd by using a {item:Petrified Leaf}. With both addons you earn the achievement **The Rootwalker**.

The missions' effects carry over to the hunting area: the *Crimson Death Blossom* makes the cocoons appear for everyone for 2 hours and reduces the rootthings' spell damage to the participants; the heart healed in *Heart Attack* weakens the Quara's spells (5% stronger while it burns).
{creature:The Rootkraken} gives 700,000 experience and is an *Archfoe* category boss in the Bosstiary.
{npc:Petaloid}, in Podzilla, trades 20 {item:Processed Blue Tea Leaves} for a {item:Podzilla's Finest}, a tea made from the blue leaves that grow inside the plant (not needed for the quest).
